title: Exercise-to-rest pulse-pressure amplification adds no demonstrated cross-hospital CAD prediction beyond its component pressures
abstract: A literature-led public-data analysis tested log peak-to-rest pulse-pressure ratio beyond flexible additive conventional exercise measures and individual pressures. Hungarian development included293 patients;independent institutional Long Beach VA evaluation included136,106 with angiographic CAD. External Brier loss changed from0.253621 to0.253631;gain-0.000010,1000 joint source-refit/target-bootstrap95%[-0.000670,0.000536]. Source cross-validation also worsened slightly. The log ratio is an additive transformation of its components,not new measured information. No reliable incremental benefit is established;this is not evidence of equivalence or clinical utility. Historical target reuse,referral differences,missingness,and incompatible protocols limit confirmation. AI-authored,author self-checked and clean-rerun;not independent peer review.
